title: Noise-Debiased Thermodynamic Variance for Local Learning Coefficient Probes
abstract: arXiv:2606.22389v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Local learning coefficient (LLC) probes offer a singularity-aware view of neural-network training, but mean-energy methods require a local loss baseline that is ambiguous at transient checkpoints. Thermodynamic variance avoids this input; under mini-batch evaluation, however, direct variance mixes cross-state loss fluctuations with same-state noise. We operationalize this route with the \emph{Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator} (SIVE), which estimates and subtracts the latter component using repeated evaluations. Conditional on any fixed retained path, unclipped SIVE is unbiased for noiseless path variance without requiring MCMC stationarity. The finite-scale diagnostic remains indexed by localization scale $h$---even a locally linear loss has tether-dependent variance---while interpretation as a Real Log Canonical Threshold (RLCT) requires additional stationary low-temperature conditions. translated_title: 面向局部学习系数探测的噪声去偏热力学方差
translated_abstract: 局部学习系数（LLC）探测为神经网络训练提供了一种感知奇异性的视角，但平均能量方法需要一个局部损失基线，而该基线在瞬态检查点处是模糊不清的。热力学方差避免了这一输入；然而在小批量评估下，直接计算的方差会将跨状态的损失波动与同状态的噪声混合在一起。我们通过“平移不变方差估计器”（SIVE）将这一路线付诸实施，该估计器利用重复评估来估计并减去后者（同状态噪声）成分。在任何固定的保留路径条件下，未截断的SIVE对无噪声路径方差是无偏的，且无需MCMC平稳性。有限尺度诊断仍然由定域尺度 $h$ 索引——即使是局部线性的损失也具有依赖于系绳的方差——而将其解释为实对数典范阈值（RLCT）则需要额外的平稳低温条件。玩具实验恢复了校准的有限尺……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出平移不变方差估计器（SIVE），通过重复评估估计并扣除小批量评估中的同状态噪声，使热力学方差在无需局部损失基线和MCMC平稳性的条件下即可无偏地探测局部学习系数。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Shift-Invariant Variance Estimator (SIVE), which estimates and subtracts same-state mini-batch noise via repeated evaluations, enabling unbiased thermodynamic-variance probing of the local learning coefficient without requiring a loss baseline or MCMC stationarity.
